as_told.title: Star Trek inspired by Phyllis Schlemmer's channelling

plain: In the mid-1970s, in Ossining, New York, Gene Roddenberry, the creator of Star Trek, is said to have sat in on a channelling session, where a medium speaks messages said to come from other beings. The researcher Greg Malatzi tells Michels the people there were "Roddenberry, Puharich, and Phyllis Schlemmer," with Schlemmer as the channeler and Andrija Puharich as a researcher of psychics. Malatzi cites a tape of the session in Puharich's archive. Michels tells his own version on another episode and goes further: he says Roddenberry "was inspired by" Schlemmer, so that the channelling fed into Star Trek. Michels also names EG&G, a company, in that story, and he does not mention Puharich. If true, one of the best-known science fiction shows took ideas from messages said to come from beyond Earth.
